observations.behavior: Adds parameterized test cases and setup for expired and non-expired admin invites, and a conditional member invite, while removing the previous single-case invite setup.
observations.code_quote: expected_invite = member_invite if admin_invite_expired else admin_invite
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the SAML invite lookup test to cover scenarios where the admin invite is expired and a fallback member invite exists, and the expected invite selection depends on expiration. This could help prevent false positives or missed invites in SAML identity assertion, but the production lookup implementation is not shown, so benefit is not demonstrated.
